messages:
alex.k: heads-up: observed a 2.8x latency spike on qwen2.5 serving at ~1am during the nightly load test. tracing shows kernel-selector choosing the fallback matmul for long seqlens > 1k.
maya: ack. which path is the selector taking? slow gemm or an emulated path? :eyes:
samuel: looks like the fallback is the 'dense_fallback' path we added for non-contiguous KV layouts. profiler shows heavy memcpy and no cublas calls.
alex.k: exact dump (sanitized):
```
PROFILE: qwen2p5 / batch=12 / seq=1100
kernel_selector: chosen_kernel=matmul_fallback
memcpy_bytes=3.2GB
cublas_calls=0
cpu_ms=120.4
gpu_ms=118.7
```
maya: interesting — this flare started after the autokernel heuristics patch that prefers packed kernels when kv_stride==1. maybe some tokenizers produce non-packed KV?
samuel: i ran a quick trace. multilang tokenization for zh + en mixes produces variable token lengths: some batches end up with per-sample seqs [64, 1024, 1100, 400]. our continuous-batching sampler currently pads to max per-batch which creates very sparse KV layout for some heads.
jia: could be the head/kv-dim reduction in the last model rollout too — we shipped a patch that reduces KV projection to 64 for some fused heads to save memory. if kernel expects head_dim % 32 == 0, it falls back.
alex.k: good point. hypothesis: combined effect of mixed-long sequences + kv_dim not aligned -> kernel selector rejects fast path -> memcpy-heavy fallback. impact visible only for qwen2.5 because of its head packing layout.
maya: propose a quick mitigation: change batching heuristic to group by rounded seq buckets (like 0-128,129-512,513-1024,1025+) for continuous sampler so we avoid mixing 1k sequences with 64s in same micro-batches. also try relaxing kernel alignment check to accept KV stride 16 for aligned GPUs.
samuel: i can prototype sampler buckets tonight and run the nightly job. also will add a kernel-selector metric to logs so we can see chosen_kernel per request.
jia: for repro, here's a minimized repro command:
```bash
make bench-model MODEL=qwen2p5 BATCHER=continuous SEQ_DISTR="mix:zh,en" BATCH=12 ITER=100
```
perf-bot: scheduled bench run 2351234578 -> /artifacts/bench-2351234578 (will post summary when done)
samuel: quick note from the first run: with sampler buckets enabled, tail latency drops from p99=380ms -> 130ms. but throughput for some shapes dipped ~6%.
maya: that's acceptable as a hotfix. long term we should: 1) make kernel-selector aware of kv_stride alignment and offer a tuned kernel for kv_dim==64 2) improve quantization/packing detection in the model loader so we don't lose SIMD advantages 3) add per-route policy to avoid mixing languages aggressively.
ajex.k: (typo) alex.k: assigning follow-ups: samuel -> prototype sampler patch & logs, jia -> validate kv-projection packing on model release, maya -> spec change for kernel-selector tests. please post PR numbers here.
samuel: will open draft PR 2353 with sampler grouping + opt-in flag. will attach before/after traces.
jia: i'll audit the model artifacts and post findings by EOD. if we see head_dim mismatch we may need a small model shim to pad KV projections to 128.
maya: thanks. if anyone hits this live, enable the route-level fallback to previous model variant for now. :thumbsup:
alex.k: closing loop later after perf-bot summary. thanks team!
